const V11_FPS=8; // real SpriteCollab sprites embedded offline
// Crop the transparent border of each sprite frame; this stabilizes apparent size across
// Idle, Walk, Attack and Hurt even when source files use different frame dimensions.
const V19_FRAME_CACHE=new WeakMap();
function v19FrameBounds(pic,sx,sy,sw,sh){
  let byImage=V19_FRAME_CACHE.get(pic);if(!byImage){byImage=new Map();V19_FRAME_CACHE.set(pic,byImage)}
  const key=`${sx}:${sy}:${sw}:${sh}`;if(byImage.has(key))return byImage.get(key);
  let bounds={x:sx,y:sy,w:sw,h:sh};
  try{
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=sw;canvas.height=sh;
    const c=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
    c.drawImage(pic,sx,sy,sw,sh,0,0,sw,sh);
    const rgba=c.getImageData(0,0,sw,sh).data;let left=sw,right=-1,top=sh,bottom=-1;
    for(let y=0;y<sh;y++)for(let x=0;x<sw;x++)if(rgba[(y*sw+x)*4+3]>28){
       if(x<left)left=x;if(x>right)right=x;if(y<top)top=y;if(y>bottom)bottom=y;
    }
    if(right>=left&&bottom>=top)bounds={x:sx+left,y:sy+top,w:right-left+1,h:bottom-top+1};
  }catch(err){} // if image is cross-origin or canvas unavailable, retain original crop
  byImage.set(key,bounds);return bounds;
}

 updateHud(now){if(!battle?.active)return;const p=current(),e=foe();for(const [who,m] of [['ally',p],['enemy',e]]){let bar=$(who+'HP'),label=$(who+'HpText');if(bar)bar.style.width=clamp(m.hp/m.maxHp*100,0,100)+'%';if(label)label.textContent=`${Math.ceil(m.hp)}/${m.maxHp} PV`;if(bar)bar.style.background=m.hp/m.maxHp<.24?'linear-gradient(90deg,#f2655f,#ffb46a)':'linear-gradient(90deg,#2de6a1,#b0ffb7)'}const en=$('energyNumber'),fill=$('energyFill'),g=$('guardStatus'),d=$('dodgeBtn');if(en)en.textContent=Math.round(battle.energy);if(fill)fill.style.width=battle.energy+'%';if(g)g.textContent=this.player.guard>0?'🛡 ESCUDO ATIVO':(this.aim.x!==null&&now<this.aim.until?'MIRA MANUAL':'MIRA AUTOMÁTICA');if(d){d.disabled=this.player.dodgeCd>0||battle.energy<12;d.querySelector('small').textContent=this.player.dodgeCd>0?this.player.dodgeCd.toFixed(1)+' s':'ESQUIVA'}const fps=$('fpsChip');if(fps)fps.textContent=`${this.fps} FPS · medidos`;let ss=skillSet(p);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){let b=document.querySelector(`[data-skill="${i}"]`),mask=$('coolMask'+i),ct=$('coolText'+i);if(!b||!mask||!ct)continue;let remain=Math.max(0,cooldowns[i]-now),pct=Math.min(100,remain/ss[i].cd*100);b.disabled=battle.energy<ss[i].cost||remain>0||battle.paused;mask.style.height=pct+'%';ct.textContent=remain>0?(remain/1000).toFixed(1)+'s':'';}}
}

function awardXP(m,amount){let events=[];m.xp+=amount;let cap=GYMS[Math.min(12,save.gym)].levelCap;while(m.level<cap && m.xp>=xpNeed(m.level)){m.xp-=xpNeed(m.level);m.level++;let oldMax=m.maxHp,info=D[m.id];m.maxHp=Math.round(info.hp*2*m.level/100+m.level+16);m.hp+=m.maxHp-oldMax;if(info.evolve&&m.level>=info.at){let before=info.name;m.id=info.evolve;info=D[m.id];m.maxHp=Math.round(info.hp*2*m.level/100+m.level+16);m.hp=m.maxHp;events.push(before+' → '+info.name)}else events.push(info.name+' Nv. '+m.level)}return events}
function xpNeed(level){return Math.round(13+level*2.3)}


// V10: geometria e busca A* adaptadas de conceitos documentados no Emerald Arena;
// esta implementacao JavaScript e independente do codigo C do GBA.
BattleEngine.prototype.clearPath=function(ax,ay,bx,by,extra=0){
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,len=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 for(const r of this.rocks){if(r.hp<=0)continue;
  const rr=r.radius+this.h*.061+extra;
  const t=len?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((r.x-ax)*dx+(r.y-ay)*dy)/len)):0;
  const cx=ax+t*dx,cy=ay+t*dy;
  if((cx-r.x)**2+(cy-r.y)**2<rr*rr)return false;
 }
 return true;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.findWaypoint=function(from,to){
 if(this.clearPath(from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y))return {x:to.x,y:to.y};
 const gap=this.h*.09,vertices=[];
 for(const r of this.rocks){if(r.hp<=0)continue;const rr=r.radius+this.h*.061+gap;
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const angle=Math.PI*2*i/8;
   let x=r.x+Math.cos(angle)*rr,y=r.y+Math.sin(angle)*rr;
   if(x>this.w*.068&&x<this.w*.932&&y>this.h*.245&&y<this.h*.83&&this.clearPath(x,y,x,y))vertices.push({x,y});
  }
 }
 const n=vertices.length,pts=[{x:from.x,y:from.y},...vertices,{x:to.x,y:to.y}],dest=n+1;
 const g=new Array(n+2).fill(Infinity),f=new Array(n+2).fill(Infinity),prev=new Array(n+2).fill(-1),closed=new Set();
 const heuristic=i=>Math.hypot(pts[i].x-to.x,pts[i].y-to.y);
 g[0]=0;f[0]=heuristic(0);
 for(let attempt=0;attempt<pts.length;attempt++){
  let best=-1;
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++)if(!closed.has(i)&&(best<0||f[i]<f[best]))best=i;
  if(best<0||!Number.isFinite(f[best]))break;
  if(best===dest){let at=dest;while(prev[at]>0)at=prev[at];return pts[at]}
  closed.add(best);
  for(let j=1;j<pts.length;j++){if(closed.has(j)||j===best)continue;
   if(!this.clearPath(pts[best].x,pts[best].y,pts[j].x,pts[j].y))continue;
   const alt=g[best]+Math.hypot(pts[best].x-pts[j].x,pts[best].y-pts[j].y);
   if(alt<g[j]){g[j]=alt;prev[j]=best;f[j]=alt+heuristic(j)}
  }
 }
 return {x:to.x,y:to.y};
};
BattleEngine.prototype.nextAiGoal=function(e,p){
 if(!this.aiReplan||this.time>this.aiReplan){this.aiGoal=this.findWaypoint(e,p);this.aiReplan=this.time+.25;}
 return this.aiGoal||p;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.segmentTouches=function(a,b,x,y,radius){
 let dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,l=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 let t=l?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a.x)*dx+(y-a.y)*dy)/l)):0;
 return Math.hypot(a.x+dx*t-x,a.y+dy*t-y)<=radius;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.elementalBurst=function(x,y,type,scale=1){
 const c=TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#f8e5af';
 const n=Math.min(52,Math.round(19*scale));this.particlesAt(x,y,c,n,120*scale);
 const wave=type==='water'?'#92f1ff':type==='fire'?'#ffe0a0':type==='electric'?'#ffff8c':'#ffffff';
 this.rings.push({x,y,r:6,life:.40,color:wave});
 if(type==='fire')for(let i=0;i<12;i++)this.particles.push({x:x+rnd(-12,12),y:y+rnd(-12,12),vx:rnd(-75,75),vy:rnd(-220,-60),life:rnd(.28,.67),max:.7,color:'#ffa43d',r:rnd(2,5)});
 if(type==='water')for(let i=0;i<10;i++)this.particles.push({x,y,vx:rnd(-140,140),vy:rnd(-160,-50),life:rnd(.3,.8),max:.8,color:'#b5f8ff',r:rnd(2,5)});
 if(type==='electric')for(let i=0;i<4;i++)this.rings.push({x:x+rnd(-18,18),y:y+rnd(-18,18),r:3,life:.2,color:'#fff68f'});
};
const originalV10Hit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(who,type,power){
 const target=who==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
 if(target.inv>0)return originalV10Hit.call(this,who,type,power);
 this.elementalBurst(target.x,target.y,type,1.15);
 this.shake=Math.max(this.shake,3.6);
 return originalV10Hit.call(this,who,type,power);
};
const originalV10Dodge=BattleEngine.prototype.dodge;
BattleEngine.prototype.dodge=function(){
 const old={x:this.player.x,y:this.player.y},stamina=battle?.energy||0;
 originalV10Dodge.call(this);
 if(old.x!==this.player.x||old.y!==this.player.y){
  this.rings.push({x:old.x,y:old.y,r:15,life:.33,color:'#e5ffff'});
  for(let i=1;i<=4;i++){const t=i/5;
   this.particlesAt(old.x+(this.player.x-old.x)*t,old.y+(this.player.y-old.y)*t,'#7deef8',5,60);
  }
 }
};

function v25Stats(){return {atk:1,def:1,speed:1,accuracy:1,conditions:[],ticker:0}}
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Initialize=function(){
  this.v25={stats:{player:v25Stats(),enemy:v25Stats()},entry:[],capture:null,impactMessage:[],stage:save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)};
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Popup=function(x,y,text,color='#ffecb7'){
  this.v25?.impactMessage.push({x,y,life:.90,max:.90,text,color});
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25PlayEntry=function(side){
  if(!this.v25)return;
  let a=side==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
  const fromX=side==='enemy'?this.w+24:-24;
  this.v25.entry.push({side,phase:0,time:0,duration:.95,fromX,fromY:this.h*.22,toX:a.x,toY:a.y-this.h*.15});
  battle.paused=true;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Ball=function(c,x,y,r,rotation=0){
  c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(rotation);c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,r*.14);c.strokeStyle='#142336';c.shadowColor='#0008';c.shadowBlur=4;
  c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.clip();
  c.fillStyle='#e6edf4';c.fillRect(-r,-r,r*2,r*2);
  const grad=c.createLinearGradient(0,-r,0,0);grad.addColorStop(0,'#ff9b87');grad.addColorStop(.45,'#e2474b');grad.addColorStop(1,'#c72c3e');c.fillStyle=grad;c.fillRect(-r,-r,r*2,r);
  c.fillStyle='#172436';c.fillRect(-r,-r*.13,r*2,r*.26);
  c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.35,0,Math.PI*2);c.fillStyle='#eff9ff';c.fill();c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,r*.16);c.strokeStyle='#172436';c.stroke();
  c.restore();c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(rotation);c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.lineWidth=1.7;c.strokeStyle='#0e1a27';c.stroke();c.restore();
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Update=function(dt){
  const v=this.v25;if(!v||!battle?.active)return;
  for(const entry of v.entry){entry.time+=dt;const t=Math.min(1,entry.time/entry.duration);if(!entry.spark && t>=.64){entry.spark=true;const col=entry.side==='enemy'?'#8ed4ff':'#ffda90';this.particlesAt(entry.toX,entry.toY,col,v.stage?31:19,95);this.rings.push({x:entry.toX,y:entry.toY,r:7,life:.38,color:col});playSound('select')}}
  const hadEntry=v.entry.length>0;
  v.entry=v.entry.filter(e=>e.time<e.duration);
  if(v.capture){let k=v.capture;k.time+=dt;
    if(!k.spark && k.time>=.48){k.spark=true;this.particlesAt(k.toX,k.toY,'#ffde9b',20,100);this.rings.push({x:k.toX,y:k.toY,r:6,life:.38,color:'#ffe3a0'})}
    if(!k.shake && k.time>=.90){k.shake=true;playSound('select')}
    if(k.time>=k.duration){v.capture=null;const m=foe();if(k.success){const caught=mon(m.id,m.level);caught.shiny=!!m.shiny;if(save.team.length<6)save.team.push(caught);else save.box.push(caught);if(caught.id<=151&&!save.caught.includes(caught.id))save.caught.push(caught.id);if(!save.seen.includes(caught.id))save.seen.push(caught.id);log(`${D[m.id].name} capturado!`);playSound('catch');persist();finishCapture(m)}else{log(`${D[m.id].name} escapou da Pokébola!`);this.particlesAt(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y,'#ff6b78',24,130);this.enemy.inv=.40;playSound('miss');battle.paused=false;persist()}}
  }
  for(const msg of v.impactMessage){msg.life-=dt;msg.y-=dt*25}
  v.impactMessage=v.impactMessage.filter(m=>m.life>0);
  if(hadEntry && !v.entry.length && !v.capture && battle.paused)battle.paused=false;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Draw=function(c){
  const v=this.v25;if(!v)return;
  for(const e of v.entry){const t=Math.min(1,e.time/e.duration),r=this.h*.022,x=e.fromX+(e.toX-e.fromX)*Math.min(1,t/.64),y=e.fromY+(e.toY-e.fromY)*Math.min(1,t/.64)-Math.sin(Math.min(1,t/.64)*Math.PI)*this.h*.13;
    if(t<.64){c.save();c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.20)';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(e.fromX,e.fromY);c.quadraticCurveTo((e.fromX+e.toX)/2,Math.min(e.fromY,e.toY)-this.h*.18,x,y);c.stroke();c.restore();this.v25Ball(c,x,y,r,t*11)}
    else{let p=(t-.64)/.36;c.save();c.globalAlpha=(1-p)*.75;c.strokeStyle=e.side==='enemy'?'#a6eaff':'#ffe0a1';c.shadowColor=c.strokeStyle;c.shadowBlur=11;for(let j=0;j<3;j++){c.lineWidth=2-j*.35;c.beginPath();c.arc(e.toX,e.toY,8+p*18+j*8,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke()}c.restore()}
  }
  if(v.capture){const k=v.capture,t=k.time,cx=k.toX,cy=k.toY,rad=this.h*.024;
    if(t<.48){const f=t/.48,x=k.fromX+(cx-k.fromX)*f,y=k.fromY+(cy-k.fromY)*f-Math.sin(f*Math.PI)*this.h*.2;this.v25Ball(c,x,y,rad,f*13)}
    else if(t<1.40){const shake=t>.88?Math.sin((t-.88)*31)*Math.min(1,(t-.88)*2)*.27:0;this.v25Ball(c,cx,cy+this.h*.035,rad,shake);
      c.save();c.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,235,172,${.4+.4*Math.cos(t*12)})`;c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,cy+this.h*.035,rad*1.36,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();c.restore();
    }else{let f=Math.min(1,(t-1.40)/.26);c.save();c.globalAlpha=1-f;c.strokeStyle=k.success?'#ffe785':'#ff7777';c.shadowColor=c.strokeStyle;c.shadowBlur=12;c.lineWidth=2;for(let j=0;j<3;j++){c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,cy,8+f*32+j*11,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke()}c.restore()}
  }
  for(const msg of v.impactMessage){c.save();c.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,msg.life*2);c.textAlign='center';c.lineWidth=3;c.strokeStyle='#081522';c.font=`900 ${Math.max(11,this.h*.031)}px system-ui`;c.strokeText(msg.text,msg.x,msg.y);c.fillStyle=msg.color;c.fillText(msg.text,msg.x,msg.y);c.restore()}
};

const v25OldDrawMon=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(actor,id,enemy,now){
 const v=this.v25,side=enemy?'enemy':'player',entry=v?.entry.find(e=>e.side===side);
 if(entry && entry.time/entry.duration<.64)return;
 if(enemy&&v?.capture?.time>=.48)return;
 return v25OldDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,enemy,now);
};
const v25OldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){v25OldDraw.call(this,now);this.v25Draw(this.ctx)};
const v25OldStart=BattleEngine.prototype.start;
BattleEngine.prototype.start=function(){this.v25Initialize();let r=v25OldStart.call(this);this.v25PlayEntry('player');this.v25PlayEntry('enemy');return r};
BattleEngine.prototype.frame=function(now){if(!this.running||!battle?.active)return;let dt=Math.min(.040,(now-this.last)/1000||.016);this.last=now;
 if(!battle.paused)this.update(dt,now);
 this.v25Update(dt);
 if(!battle?.active)return;
 this.draw(now);
 if(now-this.lastHud>80){this.updateHud(now);this.lastHud=now}
 this.frames++;if(now-this.frameStart>1000){this.fps=Math.round(this.frames*1000/(now-this.frameStart));this.frames=0;this.frameStart=now}
 this.raf=requestAnimationFrame(t=>this.frame(t));
};
const v25OldSwitchMon=BattleEngine.prototype.switchMon;
BattleEngine.prototype.switchMon=function(){let r=v25OldSwitchMon.call(this);if(this.v25){this.v25.stats.player=v25Stats();this.v25PlayEntry('player')}return r};
const v25OldNewEnemy=BattleEngine.prototype.newEnemy;
BattleEngine.prototype.newEnemy=function(){let r=v25OldNewEnemy.call(this);document.querySelector('.hudPro.enemy .v25EffectChip')?.remove();if(this.v25){this.v25.stats.enemy=v25Stats();this.v25PlayEntry('enemy')}return r};


function v25MoveSound(type){
 if(!soundEnabled)return;
 try{
  audioCtx=audioCtx||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  const now=audioCtx.currentTime, voice=audioCtx.createOscillator(), gain=audioCtx.createGain();
  const shapes={fire:['sawtooth',270,720,.19],water:['sine',480,190,.23],electric:['square',950,430,.13],psychic:['sine',390,620,.26],ghost:['triangle',330,140,.29],grass:['triangle',360,550,.20],flying:['sine',650,420,.16],rock:['triangle',150,65,.18]};
  const [wave,start,end,length]=shapes[type]||['triangle',360,520,.14];
  voice.type=wave;voice.frequency.setValueAtTime(start,now);voice.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(55,end),now+length);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.034,now);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+length);
  voice.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);voice.start(now);voice.stop(now+length);
 }catch{}
}
function v25StatusChip(where,info){
 const box=document.querySelector(`.hudPro.${where}`);if(!box)return;
 let el=box.querySelector('.v25EffectChip');if(!el){el=document.createElement('span');el.className='v25EffectChip';box.appendChild(el)}
 el.textContent=info;el.classList.remove('v25EffectPulse');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('v25EffectPulse');
}
BattleEngine.prototype.v25ApplyStatus=function(s){
 const info=V25_STATUS[s.name];if(!info)return false;
 const v=this.v25,own=v.stats.player,foeStat=v.stats.enemy,target=info.mode==='buff'?own:foeStat;
 if(info.mode==='reset') {for(const side of ['player','enemy']){let st=v.stats[side];st.atk=st.def=st.speed=st.accuracy=1} }
 else if(info.mode==='condition'){if(!foeStat.conditions.includes(info.effect))foeStat.conditions.push(info.effect);foeStat.ticker=0}
 else{
  let delta=info.amount*(info.mode==='buff'?1:-1);
  let keys=info.stat==='atkdef'?['atk','def']:info.stat==='atkspeed'?['atk','speed']:[info.stat];
  for(const key of keys)target[key]=Math.min(1.85,Math.max(.48,target[key]+delta));
 }
 const victim=info.mode==='buff'||info.mode==='reset'?this.player:this.enemy,col=TYPE_COLOR[s.type]||'#fbe1ae';
 this.particlesAt(victim.x,victim.y-this.h*.10,col,18,100);
 this.rings.push({x:victim.x,y:victim.y,r:7,life:.40,color:col});
 this.v25Popup(victim.x,victim.y-this.h*.29,info.label,info.mode==='debuff'||info.mode==='condition'?'#ffdaaa':'#b9ffde');
 v25StatusChip(info.mode==='buff'||info.mode==='reset'?'ally':'enemy',info.label);v25MoveSound(s.type);
 log(`${D[current().id].name} usou ${s.name}! ${info.detail}.`);playSound('heal');return true;
};
const v25OldUseMove=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
 if(i!==3){const move=skillSet(current())[i];const energy=battle?.energy||0;const r=v25OldUseMove.call(this,i);if(battle?.active&&energy>battle.energy)v25MoveSound(move.type);return r;}
 if(!battle?.active||battle.paused||current().hp<=0)return;
 const s=skillSet(current())[i],now=performance.now();if(cooldowns[i]>now||battle.energy<s.cost)return;
 battle.energy-=s.cost;cooldowns[i]=now+s.cd;this.attackActs.player=this.time+.37;
 if(!this.v25ApplyStatus(s)){log(`${s.name} não possui efeito configurado.`);battle.energy+=s.cost;cooldowns[i]=0}
};
const v25OldHitTarget=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(who,type,power){
 const v=this.v25;if(!v)return v25OldHitTarget.call(this,who,type,power);
 const attack=who==='enemy'?v.stats.player:v.stats.enemy,defense=who==='enemy'?v.stats.enemy:v.stats.player;
 // Accuracy penalty from Smokescreen/Sand Attack
 if(Math.random()>attack.accuracy){this.v25Popup(who==='enemy'?this.player.x:this.enemy.x,who==='enemy'?this.player.y:this.enemy.y,'ERROU','#dce6f5');playSound('miss');return}
 const calculated=power*attack.atk/Math.max(.5,defense.def);
 const victim=who==='enemy'?foe():current();
 const before=victim.hp;
 let r=v25OldHitTarget.call(this,who,type,calculated);
 const damaged=before-victim.hp;
 /* V26 critical hits are calculated and displayed only when damage is actually applied. */
 return r;
};
// Status effects tick while battle is active; paralyzed enemies skip some attacks.
const v25OldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const status=this.v25?.stats.enemy;
 if(status?.conditions.includes('paralysis'))this.enemyAttackCD+=dt*.7;
 if(status?.conditions.includes('confusion'))this.enemyAttackCD+=dt*.6;
 if(status?.speed<1)this.enemyAttackCD+=dt*(1-status.speed);
 v25OldUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
 if(!battle?.active||!this.v25)return;
 const enemy=this.v25.stats.enemy;
 if(enemy.conditions.includes('poison')){enemy.ticker+=dt;if(enemy.ticker>=3.2){enemy.ticker=0;const m=foe(),dmg=Math.max(1,Math.round(m.maxHp*.035));m.hp=Math.max(1,m.hp-dmg);this.v25Popup(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y-this.h*.30,`VENENO -${dmg}`,'#d8a7ff');this.particlesAt(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y,'#bd8bdf',11,72)}}
};

const v25OldCatchMon=catchMon;
catchMon=function(){
 if(!battle?.active||!battle.wild||!save.balls||battle.paused||!engine?.v25)return;
 save.balls--;persist();const n=$('ballCount');if(n)n.textContent=save.balls;
 const m=foe(),chance=.17+.72*(1-m.hp/m.maxHp),success=Math.random()<chance;
 engine.v25.capture={time:0,duration:1.65,fromX:engine.player.x,fromY:engine.player.y-engine.h*.16,toX:engine.enemy.x,toY:engine.enemy.y-engine.h*.15,success,spark:false,shake:false};
 battle.paused=true;log(`Pokébola lançada em ${D[m.id].name}!`);playSound('dash');
};

const v25OldRenderBattle=renderBattle;
renderBattle=function(){v25OldRenderBattle();const heading=document.querySelector('.battleHeading h2');if(heading&&save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)&&!battle.wild){heading.innerHTML=`<span class="v25BossIcon">👑</span> ${heading.textContent}`;heading.classList.add('v25BossHeading')}const footer=document.querySelector('.energyHud');if(footer&&!document.getElementById('v25Coin')){const chip=document.createElement('span');chip.id='v25Coin';chip.className='v25Coin';chip.textContent=`🪙 ${save.coins} moedas`;footer.appendChild(chip)} };

BattleEngine.prototype.v26Init=function(){
 this.v26Labels=[];this.v26Particles=[];
 this.v26Combo={hits:0,last:-99};
 this.v26PendingEnemy=null;
 this.v26LastStatusMove=null;

BattleEngine.prototype.v26Label=function(side,message,color='#edfcff',category='notice'){
 if(!this.v26Labels)this.v26Init();
 const actor=side==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
